theorems.name: Submission.ts_pwb_lusin_compact_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (A : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet A μ → μ A ≠ ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.restrict A) → ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Ambient n ℓ), (∀ k, IsCompact (K k) ∧ K k ⊆ A ∧ ContinuousOn g (K k)) ∧ μ (A \ ⋃ k, K k) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
